senses.gloss:
शञ्च् शञ्च् (= rt. श्वच्, q. v.), cl. 1. A.
शञ्चते, &c., to go.

सञ्च् सञ्च्, cl. 1. P. सञ्चति, &c. = rts.
1. सञ्ज्, 1. सज्ज्, to go, &c.
सञ्-जिहान, अस्, आ, अम्, going, moving.
सञ्जिहान सञ्-जिहान. See under सं-हा.

सञ्-चकान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. satisfied with,
pleased; praised, glorified, (Sāy. = स्तूयमान, as if
fr. rt. कै with सम्.)
सञ्चकान सञ्-चकान. See under सङ्-कङ्.

सञ्-जग्मान, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has come
together, going alone with, uniting, having inter-
course with.

सञ्-जुघुक्षा, f. the wish to conceal or cover,
desire of hiding.

सञ्जुघुक्षा सञ्-जुघुक्षा. See under सङ्-
गुह्.

सञ्-जुघुक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to conceal,
desirous of hiding.

सञ्च सञ्च, अस्, m. (perhaps fr. सञ्-चय),
a collection of leaves for writing, (according to Śab-
da-k. पुस्तक-लेखनार्थ-पत्त्र-चय = साञ्च् in
Bengālī.)
सञ्चक् सञ्-चक् (सम्-चक्). See rt. चक्.

सञ्-चकित, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly startled, trembling,
fearful, afraid; [cf. प्र-चकित.]
सञ्चक सञ्चक (?), a stamp; a disc.

सञ्चक्ष् 1. सञ्-चक्ष् (सम्-च्˚; cf. rt. ख्या),
cl. 2. A. -चष्टे, -चष्टुम्, to look at, observe,
notice, consider, contemplate, survey, examine, re-
flect upon; to enumerate; to report or relate fully;
to avoid, shun.

2. सञ्-चक्ष्, f., Ved. appearance, sight, (Sāy. सञ्-
चक्षि = सन्दर्शने सति, Ṛg-veda VI. 14, 4.)

सञ्-चक्षाण, अस्, आ, अम्, beholding at the same
time, observing, surveying, examining.

सञ्-चक्ष्य, ind. having observed, having re-
flected on, &c.

सञ्चत् सञ्-चत्, त्, m. (in Uṇādi-s. II. 85.
said to be fr. rt. 1. चि, the final of the rt. being
dropped, and स् being generally inserted after सम्,
see सञ्श्-चत्), cheating, deceit, juggling; a cheat.
सञ्चय सञ्-चय, &c. See under 1. सञ्-चि.

सञ्-चय, अस्, m. collection, gathering, heaping
up, accumulation, construction, heap, hoard, store,
multitude, number, quantity.

सञ्-चाय्य, अस्, m. a particular sacrifice at which
the juice of the acid Asclepias is drank.

सञ्चर् सञ्-चर् (सम्-च्˚; cf. सङ्-क्रम्), cl.
1. P. A. -चरति, -ते, -चरितुम्, to go or come toge-
ther, meet, join; to go or walk about, move about,
roam, wander, graze; to go through, pass through,
pervade, roam through; to go towards, come to,
arrive at, reach, attain; to go over to, pass over to,
enter; to stay, remain, live in the practice of (with
loc.); to practise (with acc.): Caus. -चारयति, -यि-
तुम्, to cause to come together, make to meet,
bring into contact; to cause to go or put in motion,
move, lead about; to cause to pass through; to cause
to go towards, convey, deliver over to, transmit,
communicate; to turn out to graze.

सञ्-चर, अस्, m. [cf. सङ्-क्रम], going or
passing through, passage, transit; a way, road, route,
course, entrance, gate, doorway; difficult passage or
progress, travelling by inaccessible routes, any narrow
road or difficult pass, a defile, a bridge over a torrent,
&c.; emanation, development (in phil.); the body;
killing.

सञ्-चार, अस्, m. passing through, passage, pro-
gress, transition, course, a passage, way, road, door-
way, entrance; the passage or entrance of the sun
into a new sign; difficult progress; difficulty, distress;
setting in motion; impelling, inciting, conveying,
leading, guiding; transmission, communication of
disease, contagion; a gem supposed to be in the
head of a serpent.
—सञ्चार-जीविन्, ई, इनी, इ, living
with difficulty or by going to others for aid, distressed,
calamitous, indigent.
—सञ्चार-पूत, अस्, आ, अम्,
purified by the course or passage (of anything).

सञ्-चरण, अस्, ई, अम्, going together, meeting,
converging; (अम्), n. the act of going together;
passing through, travelling, going, motion, setting
in motion, use.

सञ्-चारण, अम्, n. the act of setting in motion,
moving; impelling, instigating; conveying, leading,
guiding, transmission.

सञ्-चरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, walking or wandering
about; passing through.

सञ्-चरमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, going about, roaming;
passing.

सञ्-चरेण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. moving, movable,
unsteady, changeable; (अम्), n. fickleness.

सञ्-चारक, अस्, इका, अम्, conveying, transmitting,
communicating, leading; (अस्), m. a leader, guide,
messenger; an instigator; an orator; (इका), f. a
female messenger, go-between; a procuress; a pair,
brace; odour, smell.
सञ्-चारिका, f. See सञ्-चारक.

साञ्चारिक साञ्चारिक, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr. सञ्-
चार), moving about, setting in motion.

सञ्-चारित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to come together,
made to meet, brought into contact; caused to go,
set in motion, moved, impelled, driven, worked;
led, conducted, conveyed, guided; transmitted, com-
municated (as disease).

सञ्-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, going together, meeting;
moving about, going, moving, roaming, wandering,
passing through, passing; changeable, fickle, unsteady,
not permanent, transitory (= व्य्-अभिचारिन् and ap-
plied to a class of Bhāvas which are the reverse of
स्थायिन्); passing with difficulty; difficult to be
passed, inaccessible; setting in motion, impelling;
acting on, influencing; transmitted, hereditary (as
disease); contagious; (ई), m. a particular Bhāva,
(see above); air, wind; incense, perfume; (इणी),
f. a kind of scandent shrub (= हंस-पदी).
—सञ्-
चारि-भाव, अस्, m. a transitory Bhāva or feeling
(= व्यभिचारि-भाव); a concomitant feeling.

सञ्-चार्य, ind. having caused to go or move,
having conducted or conveyed or led.

सञ्चल् सञ्-चल् (सम्-च्˚), cl. 1. P. -चलति,
-चलितुम्, to move about, shake, move to and fro,
waver, oscillate, quiver, tremble; to move away,
move off, move on, depart; to start or jump up:
Caus. -चालयति, -यितुम्, to cause to move about
or tremble, put in motion, agitate; to push away,
move or drive away, remove, expel.

सञ्-चल, अस्, आ, अम्, moving about, trembling,
quivering.
—सञ्चल-नाडि, इस्, f. ‘quivering tube,’
an artery, vein, pulse.

सञ्-चलन, अम्, आ, n. f. moving about, agitation,
trembling, shaking.

सञ्चालन, अम्, n. the act of causing to move
about, shaking, agitation.

सञ्-चालयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to shake,
agitating.
सञ्-चाली, f. the shrub Guñjā.

सञ्-चाल्य, ind. having moved or thrust away,
having ejected.

सञ्चान सञ्चान, अस्, m. (according to some)
a kind of bird, species of hawk.

सञ्चि 1. सञ्-चि (सम्-चि; see rt. 1. चि), cl. 5.
P. A. -चिनोति, -चिनुते, -चेतुम्, to pile together, pile
up, heap up, accumulate, collect, gather together,
assemble; to arrange in order.
सञ्चि 2. सञ्-चि (सम्-चि). See rt. 2. चि.

साञ्चि साञ्चि (incorrect for सञ्-चिति), N. of
the ninth book of the Śatapatha-Brāhmaṇa.

सञ्-चयनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gathered or col-
lected.
सञ्-चयिक in मास-स्, q. v.

सञ्-चयित्वा (anom. ind. part.), having collected
or accumulated.

सञ्-चयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, who or what collects, col-
lecting, accumulating, gathering.

सञ्-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, heaped up, accumulated,
collected, gathered, saved, assembled, reckoned up,
enumerated; filled with, furnished or provided with,
full of; impeded, obstructed; dense, thick (as a
wood).

सञ्-चिति, इस्, f. a collection; N. of the ninth book
of the Śata-patha-Brāhmaṇa.

सञ्-चिन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, or सञ्चिन्वान, अस्, आ,
अम्, accumulating, collecting, &c.

सञ्-चेतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be accumulated or
collected.

सञ्-चेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be accumulated; to be
collected or gathered.

सञ्-चित्य, ind. having reflected, (perhaps for सञ्-
चिन्त्य.)

सञ्चित् सञ्-चित् (सम्-च्˚; see rt. 4. चित्), cl.
1. 3. P. -चेतति, -चिकेत्ति, -चेतितुम्, Ved. to observe
together, survey, view, notice; to be of the same
mind or opinion, agree together, be unanimous:
Caus. -चेतयति, -यितुम्, to observe, be aware of,
perceive.

सञ्-चिकित्वस्, आन्, उषी, अत्, one who has observed,
one who knows thoroughly.

सञ्-चेतयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, observing, being
aware of, perceiving.

सञ्चित्रा सञ्-चित्रा (सम्-च्˚), f. the plant
Salvinia Cucullata (= मूषा-कर्णी).

सञ्चिन्त् सञ्-चिन्त् (सम्-च्˚), cl. 10. P. -चिन्त-
यति, -यितुम्, to think about, meditate on, think
over, think of, reflect about (with acc.); to reflect,
consider; to design, intend, destine.

सञ्-चिन्तन, अम्, n. the act of thinking about,
considering, reflecting.

सञ्-चिन्तयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, thinking of, medi-
tating upon.

सञ्-चिन्तयित्वा (anom. ind. part.), ind. having
reflected, &c.

सञ्चिन्तित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has reflected,
&c.

सञ्-चिन्त्य, ind. having reflected or considered,
being thoughtful, musing, pondering.

सञ्चीवरय सञ्-चीवरय, Nom. -चीवरयते,
-यितुम्, to assume the dress of an ascetic.

सञ्-चोदित, अस्, आ, अम्, impelled, urged on, incited,
driven; ordered, commanded.

सञ्चूर्णय सञ्-चूर्णय (सम्-च्˚), Nom. P.
-चूर्णयति, -यितुम्, to grind to powder, commi-
nute, pulverize.

सञ्-चूर्णन, अम्, n. the act of grinding to pow-
der, comminution, crushing or breaking to pieces.

सञ्-चूर्णित, अस्, आ, अम्, completely pulverized,
comminuted; cut or broken to pieces.

सञ्चूष् सञ्-चूष् (सम्-च्˚), Pass. -चूष्यते,
to be in a state of great heat, boil up.

सञ्चेष्ट् सञ्-चेष्ट् (सम्-च्˚), cl. 1. A. -चेष्टते,
-चेष्टितुम्, to be restless or disturbed; to exert one's
self, make effort, strive, act.

सञ्-चेष्टमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being restless or
disturbed; making effort, striving.

सञ्च्यु सञ्-च्यु (सम्-च्˚), Caus. -च्यावयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to fall off, strike off, knock off,
remove.

सञ्छद् 1. सञ्-छद् (सम्-छ्˚; see rt. 1. छद्),
cl. 10. P. -छादयति, -यितुम्, to cover over, en-
velop, conceal, hide, obscure; to put on (as a gar-
ment).

सञ्-छादन, अम्, n. the act of covering or con-
cealing, obscuring.

सञ्-छाद्य, ind. having covered over or enve-
loped, &c.

सञ्-छाद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being entirely
covered over or concealed.

सञ्-छन्द्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being presented
or offered.

सञ्छिद् सञ्-छिद् (सम्-छ्˚), cl. 7. P. A.
-छिनत्ति, -छिन्त्ते, -छेत्तुम्, to cut to pieces; to
cut off, hack off, chop off; to cut through, penetrate,
pierce, split; to cut away, destroy, remove, resolve
(a doubt &c.); to decide, settle, answer (a question
&c.): Pass. -छिद्यते, to be cut to pieces; to be
cut off, &c.

सञ्-छिद्य, ind. having cut to pieces; having
cut away, &c.

सञ्-छिद्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, mutually cutting off
or cutting to pieces.

सञ्-छिद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being cut to pieces,
being hacked.

सञ्-छिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, cut to pieces, cut off;
dissipated, removed.

सञ्ज् 1. सञ्ज् (= rts. सञ्च्, 1. सज्ज्), cl. 1.
P. सञ्जति, &c., to go, move.

सञ्ज् 2. सञ्ज् (sometimes written सज्ज्,
which appears to be a form of the rt.
developed out of सज्जते, ep. for Pass. सज्यते), cl.
1. P. सजति (ep. also सज्जति), ससञ्ज (ep. also
ससज्ज), सङ्क्ष्यति, असाङ्क्षीत्, सङ्क्तुम्, to
[]
cling or adhere to, stick; to fasten: Pass. सज्यते
(ep. also सज्जते), to be attached, become attached
or connected, adhere, cling, stick: Caus. सञ्जयति,
यितुम्, Aor. अससञ्जत्, to cause to stick or cling
to; to cause to be connected or have intercourse
with: Desid. सिसङ्क्षति: Intens. सासज्यते, सा-
सङ्क्ति; [cf. Gr. σάττω, σαγή, σάγμα, σακτός,
σάκτωρ, (probably) σάκκος, σάκτας.]

सञ्जन, अम्, n. the act of clinging, adhering,
sticking.

साञ्जन साञ्जन (स-अञ्ज्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having
pigment; (अस्), m. a lizard, chameleon.
सञ्जतर सञ्जतर, अम्, n., N. of a city.

सञ्जन् सञ्-जन् (सम्-ज्˚), cl. 4. A. -जायते,
-जनितुम्, to be born or produced together with;
to be born, arise, grow, be produced, come into
existence, take place, appear, happen; to become,
be; to elapse, pass (as time); to bring forth: Caus.
-जनयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be born, bring forth,
generate, beget, produce, create, cause, form, make.

सञ्-ज, अस्, m. ‘universal producer,’ epithet of
Brahmā; of Śiva; (आ), f. a she-goat.

सञ्-जनन, अम्, n. the act of begetting, causing,
producing.

सञ्जानान, अस्, आ, अम्, being of the same mind,
agreeing; knowing, observing, understanding, watch-
ing, waiting, who or what keeps watch.

सञ्-जनयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, begetting, producing,
causing.
सञ्-जनित, अस्, आ, अम्, produced, caused, created.

सञ्-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, born, produced, grown, ap-
peared, arisen, become, aroused (often at the begin-
ning of comps. in the sense ‘becoming,’ ‘growing,’
‘grown’); elapsed, passed (as time).
—सञ्जात-
कोप, अस्, आ, अम्, growing angry, becoming enraged.
—सञ्जात-कौतुक, अस्, आ, अम्, having the curiosity
roused, becoming curious.
—सञ्जात-निर्वेद, अस्, आ,
अम्, grown despondent.
—सञ्जात-विश्रम्भ, अस्,
आ, अम्, having confidence excited, becoming confi-
dent.
—सञ्जातेर्ष्य (˚त-ईर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, becom-
ing envious.

सञ्जप् सञ्-जप् (सम्-ज्˚), cl. 1. P. -जपति,
-जपितुम्, to whisper or talk about, speak about, tell
of, report, communicate.
सञ्जय सञ्-जय. See under सञ्-जि, col. 2.

सञ्-जय, अस्, m., N. of the charioteer of king
Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; of a son of Su-pārśva; of a son of
Prati-kṣatra; of a son of Ranañ-jaya.

सञ्जर्भुराण सञ्-जर्भुराण. See under सम्-
भुर्.

सञ्-जर्भुराण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Intens.), moving
about rapidly; seizing, taking, (Sāy. = गृह्णत्, Ṛg-
veda V. 44, 5.)

सञ्जल्प् सञ्-जल्प् (सम्-ज्˚), cl. 1. P. -जल्पति,
-जल्पितुम्, to speak or talk together, converse, speak,
chatter, chat.

सञ्-जल्प, अस्, m. talking together, conversation;
confused discourse, chattering, uproar, confusion.

सञ्-जल्पत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, conversing, speaking;
chattering, babbling; talking boldly.

सञ्-जल्पमान, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking together,
conversing.

सञ्-जल्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken together, spoken,
uttered; (अम्), n. spoken words, talk.

सञ्जवन सञ्-जवन, अम्, n. (said to be fr.
rt. जु with सम्; probably for सं-यवन, fr. rt.
2. यु), a group of four houses, a quadrangle; [cf.
सं-यमन, सञ्-जीवन.]

सञ्जि सञ्-जि (सम्-जि), cl. 1. P. -जयति, -जे-
तुम्, to conquer together; to gain or acquire (by
conquest &c.), conquer entirely; to obtain or acquire
together, win.
सञ्-जयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, conquering, victorious.

सञ्-जिगीवस्, आन्, m., Ved. one who has com-
pletely conquered, victorious.

सञ्-जित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. completely conquering, win-
ning.

सञ्-जित, अस्, आ, अम्, entirely conquered, com-
pletely overcome, vanquished.
सञ्-जिति, इस्, f. complete victory.

सञ्जीव् सञ्-जीव् (सम्-ज्˚), cl. 1. P. -जीवति
(ep. also A. -ते), -जीवितुम्, to live with or together;
to live, exist, live by any business or occupation
(with inst.); to revive, be restored to life: Caus.
-जीवयति, -यितुम्, to cause to live, make alive,
vivify, bring to life, revive, re-animate, animate,
enliven; to maintain, nourish.

सञ्-जिजीवयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to bring to
life or enliven.
सञ्-जीव, अस्, आ, अम्, living together, living.

सञ्-जीवक, अस्, इका, अम्, living together; animat-
ing; (अस्), m., N. of a bull (in the Hitopadeśa).
सञ्-जीवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, living together, living.

सञ्-जीवन, अम्, n. the act of living together;
bringing to life, animating, re-animating, life-restor-
ing; a cluster of four houses, a quadrangle [cf. सञ्-
जवन]; a particular hell, (one of the twenty-one
kinds mentioned in Manu IV. 89); (ई), f. making
alive, causing life; epithet of food; a kind of elixir;
N. of Malli-nātha's commentaries on the Kumāra-
sambhava, Megha-dūta, and Raghu-vaṃśa.

सञ्-जीवमान, अस्, आ, अम्, coming to life, recover-
ing, reviving.

सञ्-जीवयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, making alive, vivify-
ing, animating; restoring to life.
सञ्जीवित, अस्, आ, अम्, vivified, enlivened, animated.

सञ्-जीविन्, ई, इनी, इ, rendering alive, enlivening,
re-animating.
सञ्-जीव्य, ind. having lived together; having lived.

सञ्जुष्ट सञ्-जुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. जुष्
with सम्), visited, frequented, inhabited, filled with.

सञ्जूर्व् सञ्-जूर्व् (सम्-ज्˚; connected with
सञ्-ज्वर्), cl. 1. P. -जूर्वति, -जूर्वितुम्, Ved. to
burn up, consume (by fire).

सञ्जृम्भ् सञ्-जृम्भ् (सम्-ज्˚), cl. 1. A. -जृम्-
भते, -जृम्भितुम्, to gape open, be unfolded,
become displayed, appear.

सञ्जॄ सञ्-जॄ (सम्-जॄ, see rt. 3. जॄ; cf. rt.
1. गृ), cl. 1. A. -जरते, &c., Ved. to sound forth
praise, to extol, (Sāy. सञ्जरेत = सम्वर्धयतु,
Ṛg-veda IV. 3, 15; सञ्जरताम् = स्तौतु, Ṛg-
veda IV. 4, 8.)

सञ्ज्ञ 1. सञ्-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, उम् (see 1. ज्ञ; cf.
1. प्र-ज्ञ), knock-kneed.

2. सञ्-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, named, called, designated
(fr. the fem. सञ्-ज्ञा below, used at the end of adj.
comps., cf. समास-स्˚); being conscious; (आ), f.
sense, consciousness, becoming aware of anything,
knowledge, understanding, intellect, thought, mind,
right mind; sign, token, symbol, gesture, gesticula-
tion; name, appellation, title, designation, term;
(in grammar) the name of anything thought of as
standing by itself, any name or noun having a special
meaning, (the expression सञ्ज्ञायाम् therefore de-
notes the use of a word in some peculiar sense
rather than in its strictly etymological meaning; for
example, as a proper name; and a derived or com-
pounded word can only be called Sañjñā when the
idea it expresses is not clearly rendered by analysis);
the technical name of any affix, &c. (e. g. the tech-
nical expressions घ, घु); N. of the Gāyatrī or
most sacred verse of the Veda, (see गायत्री); N.
of a daughter of Viśva-karman and wife of the Sun;
(अम्), n. a yellow fragrant wood, yellow sanders
(= पीत-काष्ठ).
—सञ्ज्ञा-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of
an astronomical work by Nīla-kaṇṭha.
—सञ्ज्ञाधि-
कार (˚ञा-अध्˚), अस्, m. (in Pāṇini) a heading or
presiding rule which gives a particular name to the
rules which fall under it and influences them all.
—सञ्ज्ञा-प्रकरण, अम्, n. explanation of the
grammatical Sañjñās.
—सञ्ज्ञार्थम् (˚ञा-अर्˚),
ind. for a sign.
—सञ्ज्ञा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having
consciousness, become sensible, revived, recovered;
having a name or denomination.
—सञ्ज्ञा-विषय,
अस्, m. ‘having a name for subject,’ an epithet,
attributive.
—सञ्ज्ञा-सुत, अस्, m. ‘son of Sañjñā,’
Saturn.

सञ्ज्ञा सञ्-ज्ञा (सम्-ज्˚), cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति,
जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to be of the same mind, agree
together, come to a mutual understanding, live in
harmony with (with inst. or acc., Pāṇ. II. 3, 22),
[]
understand one another (A.); to be conscious, be
aware, know, understand, comprehend; to acknow-
ledge, recognise, own (generally A.); to acknowledge
or claim as one's own, take possession of (P.); to
direct, appoint, assign, intend (for any purpose),
destine (usually A.); to think of, recollect sorrow-
fully (P., with acc. or gen., Pāṇ. 1. 3, 46, cf. Pāṇ.
II. 3, 52); to watch for: Caus. -ज्ञपयति, -ज्ञा-
पयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to be of one mind or
agree together; to appease, gratify, console, satisfy;
to cause to acquiesce or agree in, pacify, quiet (espe-
cially any animal destined for sacrifice which ought
not to be led forcibly but made to resign itself); to
cause to be conscious, animate; to make intelligible,
cause to be understood or known, cause to under-
stand, apprise, cause to recognise; to make a sign
to any one, to communicate or make anything
known by signs; to command, enjoin, instruct.
सञ्-ज्ञा, f. See above under 2. सञ्-ज्ञ.

सञ्-ज्ञु, उस्, उस्, उ, = संहात-जानु, knock-
kneed.

सञ्ज्ञु सञ्-ज्ञु. See 1. सञ्-ज्ञ, p. 1051,
col. 2.

सञ्-ज्ञक, अस्, इका, अम्, having a name, called,
named (often at the end of comps.; cf. रवि-स्).

सञ्-ज्ञपत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (ep. for सञ्ज्ञपयत्),
instructing, commanding.

सञ्-ज्ञपन, अम्, n. the act of killing, sacrificing
(an animal &c.).

सञ्-ज्ञापन, अम्, n. apprising, informing; teach-
ing; killing, slaughter.
सञ्-ज्ञपित, अस्, आ, अम्, sacrificed, killed.

सञ्-ज्ञापित, अस्, आ, अम्, killed, suffocated (as a
victim).

सञ्-ज्ञप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, apprised; killed, suffocated,
sacrificed.

सञ्-ज्ञप्ति, इस्, f. apprising, informing; killing,
slaying.

सञ्-ज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, known, understood, des-
tined or intended for.

सञ्-ज्ञान, अम्, n. knowing, understanding,
knowledge.

सञ्-ज्ञाप्य, ind. having made known by signs;
having killed.

सञ्ज्ञित, अस्, आ, अम्, named, called, designated,
denominated, termed.

सञ्ज्ञिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a name, named, termed,
that which receives a name or has a term given to
it in grammar.

सञ्ज्वर् सञ्-ज्वर् (सम्-ज्˚; cf. सञ्-जूर्व्, सञ्-
ज्वल्), cl. 1. P. -ज्वरति, -ज्वरितुम्, to be in great
fever or heat, be greatly depressed or grieved, be
afflicted or sorrowful, grieve.

सञ्-ज्वर, अस्, m. great heat or fever; heat, the
heat of fire, burning, scorching, a burn; the heat of
anger, indignation.
—सञ्ज्वर-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
full of heat or fever, hot.
—सञ्ज्वरातुर (˚र-आत्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, afflicted or affected with fever, fevered.
सञ्-ज्वारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, fevered, diseased, feverish.

सञ्ज्वल् सञ्-ज्वल् (सम्-ज्˚), cl. 1. P. -ज्वलति,
-ज्वलितुम्, to blaze up, burn brightly, flame: Caus.
-ज्वालयति, -यितुम्, to cause to blaze up or flame,
light up, illuminate, kindle, light; to inflame.
सञ्-ज्वलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, blazing, flaming, burning.

सञ्-ज्वाल्य, ind. having lighted, having kindled
(a fire &c.).
